title: Evo-DexBench: Benchmarking Generalization across Related Tasks for Dexterous Manipulation

hands.en: One type: Shadow Hand on Franka Panda, single or dual arm–hand units; 123 virtual taxels per hand.
hands.zh: 1 型：Shadow Hand＋Franka Panda，支持单臂单手／双臂双手；每手 123 个虚拟触点。

tasks.en: 30: 24 Core + 6 Gen in six interaction families; 15 single-hand and 15 bimanual tasks, each with three layouts.
tasks.zh: 30 个：24 Core＋6 Gen，6 类功能交互；单手／双手各 15 个，每任务 3 种布局。

cross_hand.en: Shadow Hand only; no matched same-task evaluation across hand types. Single and bimanual setups serve different task families.
cross_hand.zh: 仅 Shadow Hand，未验证同任务跨手型复用；单／双手配置对应不同任务类。

release.en: ManiSkill 3/SAPIEN code, 1,248 HDF5/LeRobot-v3 demos and redistributable assets public; PartNet requires separate access. KineDex training example available; no public benchmark-trained checkpoint found as of the check date.
release.zh: ManiSkill 3／SAPIEN 环境代码、1,248 条 HDF5／LeRobot-v3 示范及可分发资产已公开；PartNet 需单独授权。有 KineDex 训练例程，截至核验日未找到公开的基准训练 checkpoint。

highlight.en: Controlled related-task Core→Gen transfer with only eight demos per Gen task, testing source relatedness and breadth rather than target-task memorization; includes scene variation and tactile ablations.
highlight.zh: 以功能相关性组织 Core→Gen，每个 Gen 仅 8 条示范，检验源任务相关性与广度带来的迁移，配合场景变化和触觉消融。

evaluation_scope.en: Paper baselines cover 15 of 30 tasks in three families, using π0.5, DP-C, DP-T, KineDex and SmolVLA. Simulation-only evidence; 100 episodes per task, SR and StageScore. Published resources were inspected, not reproduced locally.
evaluation_scope.zh: 论文基线覆盖其中 3 类、15 个任务，比较 π0.5、DP-C、DP-T、KineDex、SmolVLA；为仿真评测，每任务 100 回合，报告成功率与阶段分数。本次核查资源，未本地复现。
